description: Read and write Tumblr: dashboard, blog posts, likes, queues, drafts, submissions, notes, followers, notifications and tags, plus create, edit, reblog, delete, like, follow, block and tag-filter actions on tumblr.com in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in Tumblr session.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the authenticated Tumblr user profile including username, following count, likes count, and owned blogs.

tools.name: get_user_limits
tools.description: Get the current rate limits for the authenticated user including daily posting, photo, video, audio, and follow limits.

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: Get posts from the authenticated user's Tumblr dashboard. Returns posts from followed blogs in reverse chronological order.

tools.name: get_user_likes
tools.description: Get posts liked by the authenticated Tumblr user. Returns liked posts with the total like count.

tools.name: get_user_following
tools.description: Get blogs followed by the authenticated Tumblr user with the total count.

tools.name: follow_blog
tools.description: Follow a Tumblr blog by URL.

tools.name: unfollow_blog
tools.description: Unfollow a Tumblr blog by URL.

tools.name: get_filtered_tags
tools.description: Get the list of tags the authenticated user has filtered out of their dashboard. Posts with these tags are hidden.

tools.name: add_filtered_tag
tools.description: Add a tag to the filter list. Posts with this tag will be hidden from your dashboard.

tools.name: remove_filtered_tag
tools.description: Remove a tag from the filter list. Posts with this tag will appear on your dashboard again.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Tumblr post by blog name and post ID.

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Create a new text post on a Tumblr blog using NPF format. Defaults to published state.

tools.name: edit_post
tools.description: Edit an existing Tumblr post. Only provided fields are updated.

tools.name: delete_post
tools.description: Permanently delete a post from a Tumblr blog. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: reblog_post
tools.description: Reblog a post to your Tumblr blog, optionally adding a comment.

tools.name: like_post
tools.description: Like a Tumblr post. Requires the post ID and reblog key.

tools.name: unlike_post
tools.description: Remove a like from a Tumblr post. Requires the post ID and reblog key.

tools.name: get_post_notes
tools.description: Get notes (likes, reblogs, replies) on a Tumblr post. Filter by mode to see specific note types.

tools.name: get_draft_posts
tools.description: List draft posts for a Tumblr blog. Use before_id for pagination.

tools.name: get_queued_posts
tools.description: Get posts in the queue for a blog. Queued posts are scheduled to be published automatically.

tools.name: get_submissions
tools.description: Get posts submitted to a blog by other users. Only available for blogs you own.

tools.name: get_blog_info
tools.description: Get information about a Tumblr blog including title, description, post count, and avatar.

tools.name: get_blog_posts
tools.description: Get posts from a Tumblr blog. Optionally filter by post type or tag.

tools.name: get_blog_followers
tools.description: Get the list of followers for a Tumblr blog.

tools.name: get_blog_following
tools.description: Get the list of blogs that a Tumblr blog is following.

tools.name: get_blog_likes
tools.description: Get the posts liked by a Tumblr blog.

tools.name: get_blog_notifications
tools.description: Get recent notifications for a Tumblr blog including likes, reblogs, follows, and mentions.

tools.name: search_tagged
tools.description: Search for Tumblr posts with a specific tag. Returns posts in reverse chronological order.

tools.name: get_recommended_blogs
tools.description: Get recommended Tumblr blogs to follow.

tools.name: get_blocks
tools.description: Get the list of blogs blocked by a Tumblr blog.

tools.name: block_blog
tools.description: Block a Tumblr blog. The blocked blog will no longer be able to interact with your blog.

tools.name: unblock_blog
tools.description: Unblock a previously blocked Tumblr blog.
